{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dark Edge Dancetorium''' was a building that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. It was originally used as a dancing facility, but eventually trends changed and the building was abandoned. It was later occupied by a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] gang led by the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zelice Sturm]], which used the Dancetorium as a hideout, and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled to the base and confronted Sturm and her gang.
